usedFor: Zoho CRM holds your leads, and Vonage sends the text when “New Lead” runs “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Zoho CRM, then “Send SMS” in Vonage
bestTemplate.why: A new lead gets a text sent through your Vonage account, so first contact is quick.

watchOut: “New Lead” in Zoho CRM is polling, so the text follows the next scheduled check, not the lead itself.
